coordinate_system: pixels of the input screenshot (x right, y down, origin top-left). Undistortion state as displayed in that window; not usable for homography.
prompt: Detect every distinct physical object visible in this top-down photo of a miniature warehouse workspace. List each object instance separately. Return JSON only, no prose: {"objects": [{"label": "<short noun phrase>", "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}]} where coordinates are integers normalized to 0-1000 relative to image width and height.
